issues.issue: Did the Manager fail to consider whether the misrepresentation was honestly and reasonably made?
issues.applicant_position: Manager ignored his evidence that the misrepresentation was honest and reasonable, given the third party's conduct.
issues.respondent_position: Applicant blames a third party; the innocent misrepresentation exception is narrow and not met on this evidence.
issues.result_quote: I agree with the Applicant that the Manager failed to consider whether the Applicant honestly and reasonably believed he was not withholding material information.

issues.issue: Was the procedural fairness letter deficient?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant argued the procedural fairness letter was deficient.
issues.result_quote: it is unnecessary to consider the remaining issues that arise in this case.

issues.issue: Did the Manager fail to consider the totality of the evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant argued the Manager did not consider the totality of the evidence.
issues.result_quote: it is unnecessary to consider the remaining issues that arise in this case.
